body: Both PRs are cut from main with base main: #4149 BUG-2598 is 2 commits ahead of main, #4129 STORY-2844 is 3. Neither contains an integration commit. Overlap with integration-only changes is one file each, scripts/store-writers.toml (a shared registry), and both merge into integration with no conflicts. They look self-contained on main and could train straight to main; awaiting the ruling. Until then the bases stay as they are and the rework lanes launch as planned. If the ruling is integration-only, the integration seat adds a hold against main trains on each.
subject: #4149/#4129 landing route: no integration-only dependency
